description:
DESIGN TALK (trust model, stored data). Needs ag-s99.3 first.

Goal: no registration by hand. The first valid run from a new repository + workflow file creates the deployment. Matt decided this on 2026-10-14: trust rests on GitHub OIDC and the GitHub App connection, so registration adds nothing.

Today: reports go to POST /api/agents/{id}/observations and tokens to POST /api/agents/{id}/otlp-token (docs/20-routes.md); the agent ID is in the URL and comes from the workflow's AGBREDO_AGENT_ID variable. The registration holds the GitHub App installation ID, which internal/github/github.go:70,90 uses to ask GitHub about the run, and the per-run threshold.

Questions for Matt:
- New URL without an agent ID, keeping the old ones working? How are reports matched to a deployment then (repository + workflow file from the OIDC identity)?
- Installation ID: look it up from the GitHub App (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/installation) on first run?
- Default threshold for a new deployment, and where it is changed?
- The "Enabled" switch: keep it as a way to stop accepting reports from a deployment?
- How does the dashboard show a deployment that appeared on its own (name, description, owner)?
title: Create deployments on their first valid run
